usage: As a noun, 研究 means "research" or "study" in an academic sense. It often refers to careful investigation of a topic, problem, or subject.
It is commonly used in school, university, and professional settings. You may hear it with words like 科學, 語言, or 資料.
The word is fairly neutral and standard, so it works in both spoken and written Cantonese, especially when talking about learning or academic work.
For beginners, think of 研究 as the "serious study" side of a topic, not just casual interest.
